privileged_info_for_vlm: The task is successful if the following three mappings are visible in the Zotero metadata or attachments: 1. 'Attention Is All You Need' must have 'https://github.com/tensorflow/tensor2tensor'. 2. 'BERT: Pre-training of Deep Bidirectional Transformers for Language Understanding' must have 'https://github.com/google-research/bert'. 3. 'Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition' must have 'https://github.com/KaimingHe/deep-residual-networks'.
